messages:
Ravi (platform): Heads-up: small late ingest hole in us-west (approx 90m of missing telemetry). Goal: targeted reprocess for affected shards only, avoid full tenant backfill. Thinking: preflight that simulates 'affinity override' to dedicated-pool + token-bucket bump. Need operator-visible cost + slot contention heatmap.
Evan (ops): curious about dedicated-pool affinity. If we pin to dedicated, do we get isolation or just priority? cost jump could be 2-3x. we need a per-shard estimate before we touch quotas.
Nora (eng-runtime): Dedicated gives isolation if we bind the shards to the reserved pool. Runtime caveat: warmup + model cold-start if we switch pools mid-window. Suggest a two-step: simulate affinity -> micro-canary on 1 shard -> full run. Also runtime will need to prefetch KV for that shard.
Priya (console): UX idea: preflight modal shows three panes: cost estimate, slot conflict map (routes x time), and suggested operator actions (label + affinity toggle). I can prototype. question: do we want preflight to indicate risk (SLO hit probability) or just raw metrics?
Ravi (platform): include risk score. simple high/med/low computed from expected concurrency vs current usage. Also show suggested mitigation (throttle windows, fallback routing).
Evan (ops): runbook note: to apply affinity we add label `affinity:dedi-usw-1` and quota +2 tokens to shard. snippet: 
```
redwoodctl tenant annotate acme-usw --labels affinity=dedi-usw-1
redwoodctl quota modify --tenant acme-usw --shard 42 --tokens +2 --duration 2h
```
Priya (console): API question: should console call an existing /planner/simulate endpoint, or call a new /api/v1/backfill/preflight that returns the consolidated view? Reusing planner would be faster but leaks planner internals to UI.
Nora (eng-runtime): prefer new consolidated preflight API that orchestrates planner simulation and post-processes results into UI-friendly fields. Keep planner internal.
Ravi (platform): agree. API contract should include: preflight_id, shards_considered[], estimated_cost_usd, risk_level (low/med/high), slot_conflicts (textual summary), recommended_actions[]. Also telemetry: emit preflight.requested_by and preflight.duration_ms.
Evan (ops): security: preflight output must redact tenant GUIDs and any PII. Use tenant alias only. Also limit the size of shards_considered to prevent huge responses.
preflight-bot: preflight job queued: preflight-5181002222 (simulate shards: [41,42,43]) status=queued
Nora (eng-runtime): perf note: simulation should model KV-warmup cost and cache TTLs. We'll simulate both with TTL=10m and warmup=true to estimate transient SLO risk.
Priya (console): UI will call `POST /api/v1/backfill/preflight` with body: `{ "tenant": "acme-usw", "shards": [41,42,43], "simulate_affinity": true }`. sample curl in docs: 
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"acme-usw","shards":[41]}' https://console.redwood/api/v1/backfill/preflight
# returns summarized JSON (redacted)
```
Ravi (platform): action items: Nora to implement simulation hook + kv-warmup modeling; Priya to prototype UI + request shape; Evan to update runbook commands and verify ops tokens; I'll write API ticket (platform#789) and attach a minimal schema. Who takes ownership of the ticket?
Evan (ops): I will own it. will coordinate with finance on cost metric naming: `preflight_estimated_cost_usd`.
Nora (eng-runtime): I'll open a tiny runtime PR for warmup modeling and link to platform#789.
Priya (console): I'll post prototype screenshots to #console-proto and link the API contract in the ticket by EOD.
Ravi (platform): timeline: try micro-canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC if preflight and runbook ready. Ops will run canary, runtime will watch SLOs, console will show preflight id in job history.
preflight-bot: note: retention: preflight trials kept for 7 days, metrics emitted: preflight.id=preflight-5181002222, preflight.estimated_cost_usd=45.23, preflight.risk=medium
Evan (ops): +1 on timeline. I'll make sure rollback steps include removing affinity label and draining dedicated pool.
Nora (eng-runtime): +1. I'll ensure KV warmup flag default true for affinity runs.
Priya (console): +1. will include the slot conflict heatmap mock in the prototype.
Ravi (platform): thanks team. Closing thread; will post ticket link when platform#789 is created.
